one.zh: 本地Markdown加Git的白板笔记：白板和文档是同一个文件，旁边开网页随手剪。
one.en: Whiteboard notes on local Markdown and Git: a board and a document are one file, with the web beside it for clipping.

one.zh: 任务就是笔记里的一行「- [ ]」：今天、日历、四象限，到点在Mac上提醒。
one.en: A task is a “- [ ]” line in your notes: today, calendar, four quadrants, and reminders on your Mac.

one.zh: 读英文论文：每段原文下面跟一段译文，问AI的回答带出处。
one.en: Read English papers with a translation under every paragraph; answers from AI cite where they come from.

one.zh: 开会和网课的实时双语字幕，还能帮你写纪要和课堂笔记。
one.en: Live bilingual captions for meetings and online classes, plus minutes and class notes.

one.zh: 接管浏览器的新标签页：打开的标签按网站摆好，快捷书签经iCloud同步。
one.en: Takes over the browser’s new tab: open tabs sorted by site, quick bookmarks synced through iCloud.

one.zh: 把和AI聊懂的、PDF和网页挑出值得记的做成问答卡，一键送进Anki。
one.en: Turns what you worked out with AI, and what is worth keeping from PDFs and web pages, into Q&A cards sent to Anki in one click.

one.zh: 按一个键说出问题，AI看着你的屏幕回答。
one.en: Press a key and ask out loud; AI answers looking at your screen.

one.zh: 框住外语词，马上出这句里的意思，一键记进Anki。
one.en: Box a foreign word to see what it means in this sentence, and save it to Anki in one click.

one.zh: Mac上的英文打字助手：拼错、不会说，按Tab改好。
one.en: An English typing helper for the Mac: misspelled or stuck, press Tab to fix it.

one.zh: 给Claude Code、Codex套的Mac窗口：每一步你都看得懂。
one.en: A Mac window around Claude Code and Codex: you can follow every step.

label.zh: 待办旁边放「在画布今日里打开」
label.en: Put “Open in Canvas Today” on to-dos

desc.zh: 点开一条待办，最下面多一个按钮，跳到画布今日里的同一条
desc.en: Open a to-do and a button at the bottom jumps to the same one in Canvas Today

off.zh: 装了以后：待办点开能直接跳过去
off.en: Once installed: jump straight there from a to-do

on.zh: 点开待办，最下面多了「在画布今日里打开」
on.en: To-dos now end with “Open in Canvas Today”

offDone.zh: 待办里不再放「在画布今日里打开」
offDone.en: To-dos no longer show “Open in Canvas Today”

desc.zh: 画布今日也在用「{vault}」：清单里每一条就是这边笔记里的一行
desc.en: Canvas Today uses “{vault}” too: each item in its lists is a line in these notes

off.zh: 装了以后：打开就认这个库，不用另外选
off.en: Once installed: it opens this vault, nothing to choose

desc.zh: 画布笔记也在用「{vault}」：清单里每一条就是那边笔记里的一行
desc.en: Canvas Notes uses “{vault}” too: each item in these lists is a line in its notes

off.zh: 画布今日自己就能用这个库；装了画布笔记能在同一个库里写笔记
off.en: Canvas Today works with this vault on its own; with Canvas Notes you write notes in the same vault

label.zh: 「打开笔记，到这一行」用画布笔记打开
label.en: Open “Open note at this line” in Canvas Notes

desc.zh: 关了用系统里默认打开.md的软件
desc.en: When off, the app your Mac uses for .md files opens it

off.zh: 装了以后：详情里点一下跳到那篇笔记的那一行
off.en: Once installed: one click in a task jumps to that line of the note

on.zh: 「打开笔记，到这一行」会跳进画布笔记
on.en: “Open note at this line” now jumps into Canvas Notes

offDone.zh: 「打开笔记，到这一行」改用系统默认的软件
offDone.en: “Open note at this line” now uses your Mac’s default app

desc.zh: 主题、界面风格、窗口背景和画布笔记一样，那边换了这边跟着换
desc.en: Theme, layout style and window background match Canvas Notes and change when it does

off.zh: 装了以后：主题和窗口背景跟着它
off.en: Once installed: theme and window background follow it

label.en: Put “Read in ParaRead (bilingual)” in the PDF “⋯” menu

desc.zh: 同一份PDF在ParaRead里打开，原文下面跟着译文读
desc.en: Opens the same PDF in ParaRead, with a translation under each paragraph

off.zh: 装了以后：PDF能一键换到ParaRead读双语
off.en: Once installed: switch a PDF to ParaRead for bilingual reading in one click

on.en: The PDF “⋯” menu now has “Read in ParaRead (bilingual)”

offDone.en: The PDF “⋯” menu no longer offers ParaRead

label.zh: 画布笔记的PDF能一键换到这里读
label.en: Canvas Notes PDFs open here in one click

desc.zh: 画布笔记里PDF的「⋯」多一项「在ParaRead里读（双语）」
desc.en: The PDF “⋯” menu in Canvas Notes gets “Read in ParaRead (bilingual)”

off.zh: 装了画布笔记以后：那边的PDF能一键换到这里读双语
off.en: With Canvas Notes installed: its PDFs switch here for bilingual reading in one click

on.zh: 画布笔记PDF的「⋯」里多了「在ParaRead里读（双语）」
on.en: The PDF “⋯” menu in Canvas Notes now has “Read in ParaRead (bilingual)”

offDone.en: The PDF “⋯” menu in Canvas Notes no longer offers ParaRead

label.en: ParaRead can write into paired notes

desc.zh: ParaRead里问的、划的线，写进同一篇「<名字> 笔记.md」，能撤回
desc.en: Questions and highlights from ParaRead go into “<name> notes.md”, undoable

off.zh: 装了以后：在ParaRead里问的也记进这边的笔记
off.en: Once installed: what you ask in ParaRead lands in these notes too

on.zh: ParaRead问的和划的线会写进配对笔记；ParaRead里看到的也是开着
on.en: ParaRead questions and highlights now go into paired notes; ParaRead shows it on too

offDone.en: ParaRead no longer writes into the vault

label.zh: 问的和划的线写进画布笔记的配对笔记
label.en: Write questions and highlights into Canvas Notes

desc.zh: 在这里问的、划的线，写进画布笔记库里的「<名字> 笔记.md」，能撤回
desc.en: Questions and highlights from here go into “<name> notes.md” in the Canvas Notes vault, undoable

off.zh: 装了画布笔记以后：在这里问的也记进那边的笔记
off.en: With Canvas Notes installed: what you ask here lands in its notes too

on.zh: 问的和划的线会写进配对笔记；画布笔记里看到的也是开着
on.en: Questions and highlights now go into paired notes; Canvas Notes shows it on too

offDone.zh: 不再往画布笔记的库里写
offDone.en: No longer writes into the Canvas Notes vault

label.en: MeetCaption can write into this vault

desc.zh: 上课、开会的双语字幕和纪要写成一篇笔记，放进「课程/<课名>/」，能接着问AI、出卡
desc.en: Bilingual captions and minutes from classes and meetings become a note in “Courses/<course>/”, ready for AI and cards

off.zh: 装了以后：课堂笔记、会议纪要直接进库
off.en: Once installed: class notes and meeting minutes go straight into the vault

on.zh: MeetCaption的纪要和课堂笔记会写进「课程」
on.en: MeetCaption minutes and class notes now go into “Courses”

offDone.en: MeetCaption no longer writes into the vault

label.en: To-dos from MeetCaption go into your lists

desc.zh: 会上说「周三前交」这类话，在纪要里记成一行「- [ ]」；画布今日照样排进日子、到点提醒
desc.en: Things like “due Wednesday” said in a meeting become a “- [ ]” line in the minutes; Canvas Today schedules and reminds as usual

off.zh: 装了以后：会上答应的事自己进清单
off.en: Once installed: what you promise in a meeting lands in your lists

on.zh: 会上说到的待办会进清单
on.en: To-dos said in meetings now go into your lists

offDone.en: MeetCaption no longer writes to-dos into minutes

desc.zh: 画布笔记里已经带着它；浏览器里也装了时，快捷书签经iCloud几边一样
desc.en: Canvas Notes already includes it; with the browser one installed too, quick bookmarks match everywhere through iCloud

off.zh: 画布笔记里已经带着它；装了浏览器那边的，快捷书签几边一样
off.en: Canvas Notes already includes it; install the browser one and quick bookmarks match everywhere

desc.zh: 这边出卡和ChatCards用同一种卡片「学习卡 · 问答」，在Anki里一起复习
desc.en: Cards made here and in ChatCards use the same note type, “Study card · Q&A”, so you review them together in Anki
